claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns Q with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P with success at least 0.39 under the heuristics of proof.md section 9, and all classical work, preprocessing included, is bounded by 2^120.834000 dense-Fp12 units (ledger: proof.md section 8). Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes certificates, pool, region, yield, cost, ledger, linear algebra, descent and every declared bound. quick=true skips the supporting audits [6], [6b], [11], [11b], [12] (listed as skipped) to fit the 20 s run; quick=false runs them (about 30 s).
